meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查你电脑上的 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 安装状态，对比最新源码，给出通过/警告/失败的报告，并提供修复建议。它不会修改你的设置。
howto.when: 当你说“医生”或“健康检查”，或提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex，或安装、更新、配置后 Codex 行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查 LazyCodex 安装是否健康。
say.note: Claude 会开始诊断并生成报告。

say.text: 诊断一下我的 Codex CLI 配置。
say.note: Claude 会对比当前配置与最新安装器。

say.text: 看看我的 LazyCodex 版本是不是最新的。
say.note: Claude 会检查版本并报告差异。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude diagnoses the health of your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation, compares against the latest sources, and produces a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence and remediation suggestions. It never mutates your config.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "doctor" or "health check", or mention LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or if Codex behaves oddly after install, update, or config change.

say_en.note: Claude will run diagnosis and produce a report.
Claude will compare config against latest installer.

say_en.text: Is my LazyCodex version up to date?
say_en.note: Claude will check version and report differences.
